LanguageData.MeleeWeapon_Guitar.description: A plucked string music instrument. Upon closer inspection, it is actually a Mexican vihuela, a guitar-like string instrument from 19th-century Mexico with five strings and typically played in mariachi groups. Seems like people already forget how to play this instrument though.
